summary: GeneralPurposeEstimate::new panics for encoded lengths near usize::MAX because its rounding formulas add 7 or 3 before division. The fix divides first and adds one for a nonzero remainder, preserving the estimates without overflowing. The regression test added by the fix checks both estimates against u128 calculations, including inputs through usize::MAX. Reversing the constructor should trigger the chunk-count overflow panic first. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: Overflow when calculating number of chunks in input
